subject: Post-call: Vanguard evaluation — success metrics, test plan & owners
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguardai.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@vanguardai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Vanguard evaluation — success metrics, test plan & owners

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on the end goals. Capturing a quick recap and proposed next steps so we have an explicit evaluation plan to share with your engineering and procurement teams.

Summary of objective
- Validate Redwood inference for VanguardAI document-understanding workloads (LLM-powered extraction + reranking) under realistic production traffic.

Proposed success metrics (please confirm):
- Latency: p95 generation <= 250ms for 256-token requests (measured at Redwood edge).
- Throughput: sustained 80 req/s across a 5 node dedicated pool (peak bursts to 150 req/s).
- Cost: target blended cost <= $0.0035/token during evaluation (including caching) — goal is unit economics that beat your existing provider.
- Quality: precision@K >= 0.85 on the provided labeled set; false positive rate for entity extraction < 2%.

Test plan highlights
- Week 1 (July 21–25): integration & baseline smoke tests (latency/throughput profile).
- Week 2 (July 28–Aug 1): controlled load test using sample traffic + quality evaluation against labeled set.
- Week 3 (Aug 4–8): extended soak and cost profiling; final readout with recommendations.

Owners & asks
- Vanguard side: confirm engineering owner for load tests (Liam?), and procurement contact for pricing/contract (procurement@vanguardai.com).
- Redwood side: Ben will lead test harness + infra config; Jordan will own pricing/SLA draft.

Attachments: vanguard-success-matrix.xlsx (template for KPIs) and redwood-test-harness-spec.md (sample test cases and data formats).

Next steps
- Liam / Sofia: confirm owners + any additional success metrics by EOD Monday 7/21.
- Ben / Jordan: we’ll prepare an infra runbook and a preliminary SLA PDF for procurement.

--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguardai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@vanguardai.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Vanguard evaluation — success metrics, test plan & owners

Thanks, Irene — that looks great and very thorough. Quick clarifications from our side: 
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms is our stretch goal; for acceptance we can provisionally accept p95 <= 350ms for the first two weeks as long as we see an improving trend with config changes.
- Throughput: 80 req/s sustained is accurate for our baseline; we will test 150 req/s for burst handling but can tolerate degraded p99 under bursts.
- Quality: precision@K target is fine; we'll provide the labeled set by Monday.

Owners:
- Engineering lead for the evaluation: Sofia Martinez (cc’d).
- Procurement contact: procurement@vanguardai.com.

We’ll review the PRD and the KPI template and revert with any additions. Confirming we can start smoke tests July 21.

—
Liam
Head of Platform | VanguardAI
liam@vanguardai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@vanguardai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguardai.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Vanguard evaluation — success metrics, test plan & owners

Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. A few operational notes on how we’ll measure the KPIs and what I’ll deliver this week: 
- Measurement methodology: we’ll run distributed clients from three regions (us-west, us-east, eu-west) to capture network variance; all latency numbers will be recorded at the Redwood edge and at your app gateway to show delta.
- Throughput test harness: I’ll deploy a load generator with replayed traffic that matches your sample distribution (burstiness and token-length histogram).
- Costing: we’ll capture token-level billing with an annotation layer so we can attribute cache hits separately. Expect a CSV per run and a consolidated cost-per-token report.

Deliverables by EOD Wed 7/23:
- redwood-test-harness-spec.md (detailed test cases + run commands) — attached to this thread.
- Initial smoke run results and a baseline latency/throughput CSV.

Question for Vanguard: do you have a preference on the exact labeled set for quality (random sample vs. stratified by document type)? Stratified usually surfaces edge-case regressions faster.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Principal SRE (Performance) | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: procurement@vanguardai.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguardai.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Vanguard evaluation — success metrics, test plan & owners

Hi Jordan / Irene,

Procurement here — we’ll need a draft SOW and pricing attachment that outlines the evaluation period, termination rights, and any credits tied to SLA targets. Can you provide a PDF we can circulate internally? We also require a point of contact for security questions (SOC2 scope, data retention).

If you can send the draft SLA and a high-level cost estimate by COB Thursday 7/24 that would keep things on schedule.

Thanks,
VanguardAI Procurement
procurement@vanguardai.com
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: procurement@vanguardai.com, Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguardai.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@vanguardai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Vanguard evaluation — success metrics, test plan & owners

Thanks — Jordan and I are on it. Quick status update and firm next steps: 
- Jordan will upload a draft SLA/SOW and preliminary pricing (redwood-sla-draft.pdf) to the shared drive by EOD Thu 7/24. Jordan, please loop in Legal if any non-standard clauses are expected.
- Ben will run the smoke test on Mon 7/21 (results attached) and will share the baseline CSV + cost report by Wed 7/23.
- Vanguard to provide labeled set (prefer stratified by document type) by Mon 7/21 so Ben can run quality evaluation in Week 2.
- Procurement: once you have the SLA PDF we can schedule a 30-minute review with Legal — suggest Fri 7/25 10:00am PT if that works.

I’m adding a very small acceptance matrix here so everyone is explicit on the gating criteria we’ll evaluate at the end of Week 2: 
- Gate A (Integration): API integration verified, sample requests flowing, smoke tests green.
- Gate B (Performance): p95 <= 350ms (accept), move towards 250ms target; throughput sustained at baseline 80 req/s.
- Gate C (Quality): precision@K >= 0.82 (accept), target 0.85+ with optimization.
- Gate D (Cost): cost trend projection <= $0.004/token (accept), target <= $0.0035/token.

If no objections I’ll lock the timeline and update the Drive folder with the attachments and links (see DocuSign link for an opt-in statement for the evaluation).

Best,
Irene
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
